newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet premiums firm, arb to Gulf remains open.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet premiums firm, arb to Gulf remains open.

text.p: European jet fuel prices were weaker in line with underlying futures on Tuesday but premiums were unchanged to firmer, traders said.
Nov IPE futures were $4 easier at $223.00, helped lower by speculative selling of Brent crude futures.
Premiums were firm because refiners continued to put jet and heating oil supplies into diesel. The arbitrage to the Caribbean and Gulf remains open, traders said.

Jet fuel cargoes cif NWE were at Nov IPE +$30 for early November. In the Med early November was unchanged at fob Med high +$5/7 for EU-qualified material. A prompt barge was traded at Nov IPE +$34.5, around $1 higher.
